signs.line: First spark of the year — you start things others only talk about.
The patient gardener — what you touch tends to grow and stay.
Two minds, one mouth — you translate between worlds for a living.
The tide — you feel first, guard fiercely, and remember everything.
The clear sun — rooms change temperature when you walk in.
The refiner — you keep what works and quietly fix the rest.
The balance point — you weigh things until they turn out fair.
Deep water — you see through people, and love like it matters.
The arrow — far horizons and honest words, in that order.
The mountain goat — you climb because the top is there.
The water-bearer — you pour ideas into people and move on.
Two fish, both directions — you dream in languages others have to learn.

animals.line: quick-witted, resourceful, first through the door
steady strength that finishes what it starts
the only mythical one — big plans, bigger heart
wise, private, always three moves ahead
kind, artistic, at home in beauty
clever, playful, solves what puzzles others
loyal, fair, the friend people deserve
generous, honest, enjoying the feast of life
